title: Don't go wrong with vitamin D
abstract:
“Plant” vitamin D2, commonly prescribed and offered in supplements, could weaken our immune defenses by reducing vitamin D3 levels.  
For decades, health authorities considered vitamins D2 and D3 to be equivalent and interchangeable. This presumption…
